# g07 – Constrained optimization problem

## Definition
- **Objective**: Minimize f(x)
- **Variables**: n = 10
- **Domain**: -10 ≤ x_i ≤ 10 for i = 1, ..., 10

## Mathematical Formulation

### Objective Function
```math
f(x) = x_1^2 + x_2^2 + x_1 x_2 - 14 x_1 - 16 x_2 + (x_3 - 10)^2 + 4 (x_4 - 5)^2 + (x_5 - 3)^2 + 2 (x_6 - 1)^2 + 5 x_7^2 + 7 (x_8 - 11)^2 + 2 (x_9 - 10)^2 + (x_{10} - 7)^2 + 45
```

### Constraints
```math
g_1(x) = -105 + 4 x_1 + 5 x_2 - 3 x_7 + 9 x_8 \leq 0
```
```math
g_2(x) = 10 x_1 - 8 x_2 - 17 x_7 + 2 x_8 \leq 0
```
```math
g_3(x) = -8 x_1 + 2 x_2 + 5 x_9 - 2 x_{10} - 12 \leq 0
```
```math
g_4(x) = 3 (x_1 - 2)^2 + 4 (x_2 - 3)^2 + 2 x_3^2 - 7 x_4 - 120 \leq 0
```
```math
g_5(x) = 5 x_1^2 + 8 x_2 + (x_3 - 6)^2 - 2 x_4 - 40 \leq 0
```
```math
g_6(x) = x_1^2 + 2 (x_2 - 2)^2 - 2 x_1 x_2 + 14 x_5 - 6 x_6 \leq 0
```
```math
g_7(x) = 0.5 (x_1 - 8)^2 + 2 (x_2 - 4)^2 + 3 x_5^2 - x_6 - 30 \leq 0
```
```math
g_8(x) = -3 x_1 + 6 x_2 + 12 (x_9 - 8)^2 - 7 x_{10} \leq 0
```

## Best Known Value
f(x*) = 24.306209
